name: chip-agent-erp
description: 芯片代理商客户订单进度管理系统（本地桌面版）

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @erp/shared build && pnpm --filter @erp/domain build && pnpm --filter @erp/db build && pnpm --filter @erp/tools build
scripts.package:portable: node scripts/extract-electron.mjs && pnpm --filter @erp/desktop build && node scripts/make-portable.mjs
scripts.package:installer: node scripts/extract-electron.mjs && pnpm build && cd apps/desktop && node ../../node_modules/electron-builder/out/cli/cli.js --config electron-builder.yml
